name: bare-bundle-id
description: Construct a unique ID for a bundle

exports.name: id
exports.description: Returns a 32-byte BLAKE2b hash of `bundle`'s sorted file entries (path, contents, and mode), uniquely identifying the bundle's contents.

params.name: bundle
params.description: The [`bare-bundle`](https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-bundle) instance to hash; its file entries are sorted by path before hashing, so the ID is stable regardless of the order they were written in.
